topic: Emergency Fund Guide for Young Adults
caption:
Salary aati hai aur pehle week mein hi gayab ho jaati hai?
Single emergency tumhari saari savings zero kar sakti hai agar safety net nahi hai.
Emergency fund build karna koi rocket science nahi hai, bass ek simple habit hai.
Tumne abhi tak kitne mahine ka emergency fund ready rakha hai? Comment karke batao!

Follow karo @ctrl_thoughts_ for daily finance ideas.

Sirf educational purpose ke liye hai, financial advice nahi hai.
